messages.content:
This is a synthetic protocol test, not real law. Author exactly one AU from the explicit fictional rule below, preserving its emergency exception. Return the K0 envelope aus, assessed_scope_ids, next_action. AU keys claim, kind, evidence_ids, limits. Use kind procedural_rule, evidence_ids ["e1"], assessed_scope_ids ["r1"], and next_action {"tool":"finish_case","reason":"work_scope_complete"}. Only JSON, no markdown.
SOURCE r1/e1:
Under this fictional test rule, an applicant must receive notice and an opportunity to respond before an adverse decision. This requirement does not apply in an emergency.

ebnf:
root ::= "{" "\"aus\":" aus "," "\"assessed_scope_ids\":" scopes "," "\"next_action\":" action "}"
aus ::= "[" (au ("," au){0,7})? "]"
au ::= "{" "\"claim\":" text "," "\"kind\":" kind "," "\"evidence_ids\":" refs "," "\"limits\":" nullable (",\"replace_id\":" replacement)? "}"
replacement ::= "null"
kind ::= "null" | "\"holding\"" | "\"standard_of_review\"" | "\"statutory_hook\"" | "\"procedural_rule\"" | "\"fact_pattern_rule\"" | "\"foreign_law\"" | "\"other\""
nullable ::= "null" | text
refs ::= "[" ref ("," ref)* "]"
ref ::= "\"e1\""
scopes ::= "[" (scope ("," scope)*)? "]"
scope ::= "\"r1\""
action ::= "{" "\"tool\":" "\"open_region\"" "," "\"scope_ids\":" open-scopes "}" | "{" "\"tool\":" "\"search_source\"" "," "\"query\":" text "}" | "{" "\"tool\":" "\"get_drafts\"" "}" | "{" "\"tool\":" "\"finish_case\"" "," "\"reason\":" finish-reason "}"
finish-reason ::= "\"work_scope_complete\"" | "\"needs_context\""
open-scopes ::= "[" scope ("," scope)* "]"
text ::= "\"" json-char* "\""
json-char ::= [\x20-\x21\x23-\x5b\x5d-\uD7FF\uE000-\U0010FFFF] | "\\" (["\\/bfnrt] | "u" scalar-hex) | "\\u" [dD] [89aAbB] hex hex "\\u" [dD] [c-fC-F] hex hex
scalar-hex ::= [0-9a-cA-Ce-fE-F] hex hex hex | [dD] [0-7] hex hex
hex ::= [0-9a-fA-F]
